_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profile_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "onboarding_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("onboarding_completed" IN (0, 1)), "active_goal_id" TEXT NULL, "active_nutrition_target_id" TEXT NULL, "latest_assessment_id" TEXT NULL, "active_workout_plan_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assessments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "step" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "data" TEXT NOT NULL, "consent_version" TEXT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "consents" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL, "accepted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "assessment_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL, "warnings_acknowledged" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("warnings_acknowledged" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "activated_at" INTEGER NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "nutrition_targets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL, "config_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_plans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "generator_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "catalog_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "assessment_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "split" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" TEXT NOT NULL, "days_per_week" INTEGER NOT NULL, "session_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "warnings" TEXT NOT NULL, "rationale" TEXT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "activated_at" INTEGER NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_days" ("plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_plans (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL, "focus" TEXT NOT NULL, "warmup_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "estimated_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "exercises" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("plan_id", "id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "day_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL, "focus" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "planned" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "energy" INTEGER NULL, "discomfort" TEXT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "set_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "exercise_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "set_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rir" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "logged_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_generation_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "model_version" TEXT NULL, "prompt_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "input_tokens" INTEGER NULL, "output_tokens" INTEGER NULL, "error_code" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "custom_foods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein" REAL NOT NULL, "carbs" REAL NOT NULL, "fat" REAL NOT NULL, "serving_grams" REAL NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal" TEXT NOT NULL, "food_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "grams" REAL NULL, "kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein" REAL NOT NULL, "carbs" REAL NOT NULL, "fat" REAL NOT NULL, "quality" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_ref" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meal_plans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "prompt_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "catalog_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "activated_at" INTEGER NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
